description: Render the nearest RAOB (radiosonde) sounding as a Skew-T log-P + hodograph chart image for visual analysis: temperature/dewpoint traces, wind barbs, height-banded hodograph, and a derived-indices table (CAPE/CIN, lifted index, PWAT, shear, LCL). Soundings launch at 00Z/12Z so data can be hours old. Use get_sounding for the raw profile numbers. Example: {"location": "Norman, OK"}.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

location.description: Free-text place: city ("Denver"), city+state ("Portland, OR"), US ZIP ("50219"), or "lat,lon" ("39.74,-104.99"). Provide either this OR explicit lat+lon, not both.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

scale.description: Raster scale factor (2 = retina; higher = larger image payload)

name: get_sounding_chart
title: Get sounding chart
